verdicts.evidence: Only the seller who owns the listing may pause or resume it; other sellers, buyers and admins are refused (403), an unknown caller 401, an unknown listing 404. Rationale: smallest reading of "los vendedores". (A1 ← Q1)

a paused listing is left out of search for everyone (owner included), refuses new orders with a 4xx..., stays readable by id with status `paused`, and existing orders and the orders list are untouched. (A3 ← Q3, rule)
A new order on a paused listing is refused with 409 (conflict with the listing's state), after the existing order checks. Rationale: state conflict, not a permission problem. (A10 ← Q11, clarify)

"Sin perder su ranking" keeps the score: rankScore is not changed by pause or resume; after resume the listing sits wherever that score places it with the existing tie-break. No position is reserved. (A2 ← Q2)
Repeated actions are refused with 409: pausing a paused listing, resuming an active one. Rationale: explicit, reversible, no silent success. (A4 ← Q4)
